derivative_linearization.hinge_derivative: analytic Jangle slope and SO(3) logarithm derivative
derivative_linearization.interpretation: Kinematic and controller-rate identities are exact. Fixed-state loads and measurements are at most quadratic in derivatives; symmetric physical probes extract their linear coefficient. No inertia threshold or matrix-entry snapping is applied.

node_coordinates.order: interleaved body translation / L and spatial rotation in radians

discretization.convention: Material arc coordinate s in [-L/2,L/2]; theta=acos(2*arc/L-1), decreasing pi to zero. Gamma=sum A_k sin(k theta). Weighted residual=(2/pi) sum R_i sin(k theta_i) delta_theta_i.
discretization.scope: Fourier modes are per logical lifting beam; refine mode count and structural intervals independently. Local flow defects need not vanish in a truncated series.

initial_conditions.interpretation: Complete finite descriptor subspace, including constitutive relaxation and integrator chains; no selected-mode truncation.

diagnostics.projection: Left mass-dual projection with complete real conjugate pairs; algebraic input lift uses the full finite subspace.

cases.source:
! Original OpenSwing harmonic verification example. SI input units.
! Fixed root, axial stiffness k=500 N/m, tip mass m=2 kg, damping time .02 s.
! Engine setting is a force in N along +y. Set gravity to zero, alpha=0.
! Tip y response per unit setting: 1 / [500*(1+i*.02*omega)-2*omega^2].
Name
Instrumented spring-mass demonstrator
End
Unit
L 1.0 m
T 1.0 s
F 1.0 N
End
Constant
9.80665 1.225 340.294
End
Reference
2 1 2
End
Ground
1 0 0
End
Weight
1 2 0 2 0 19.6133
End
Engine
1 0 1 2 0 2 0 0 1 0 1 0 -1 0 0
End
Beam 1
Axial spring
t y EA tdeps
0 0 1000 .02
2 2 1000 .02
End

! Default body-aligned pylon-tip pitot, accelerometer and GPS.
Sensor
1 1 0 0 0 .2
2 1 2 .3 2 .2
End

node_coordinates.order: interleaved body translation / L and spatial rotation in radians

discretization.convention: Material arc coordinate s in [-L/2,L/2]; theta=acos(2*arc/L-1), decreasing pi to zero. Gamma=sum A_k sin(k theta). Weighted residual=(2/pi) sum R_i sin(k theta_i) delta_theta_i.
discretization.scope: Fourier modes are per logical lifting beam; refine mode count and structural intervals independently. Local flow defects need not vanish in a truncated series.

diagnostics.projection: Left mass-dual projection with complete real conjugate pairs; algebraic input lift uses the full finite subspace.

scope: Analytical spring, finite-wing circulation and supported heave/pitch references. No ASWING executable or experimental aircraft validation.
